title: Notice Fixture
problem: Warp's central claim is that AI agents file tax registrations, set up UI/SUTA, resolve tax notices, and handle quarterly filings across 10,000+ jurisdictions - at a 5 minute median filing time and <2% error rate (warp.co/a). The thing the public surface does not publish - and that any operator with a multi state payroll book will privately tell you is the actual constraint - is a trustworthy, auditable evaluation harness for those agents.
direction: A per jurisdiction, per form regression harness for tax compliance agents - the release gate that lets Warp's AI agents file faster and prove it.
why: <2% error rate, 5 min filing (warp.co/a) is a target you can continuously verify with this artifact - and that's the kind of thing a Sound Ventures board member loves.

archetypes.name: central evidence replay
archetypes.trigger: central signal changes while claim context is stale
archetypes.expected: block release until cited evidence is regenerated

archetypes.name: claim boundary probe
archetypes.trigger: claim handoff crosses a policy or trust boundary
archetypes.expected: route to reviewer with evidence packet

archetypes.name: agents regression harness
archetypes.trigger: agents behavior regresses against the last accepted fixture
archetypes.expected: open a regression issue with trace and benchmark delta

archetypes.name: registrations operator packet
archetypes.trigger: registrations output needs a human-readable audit packet
archetypes.expected: accept only if decision claims cite fixture evidence
